dispositions.reason: Reports rates of change of CO conversion over time (+0.62% h-1, -0.85% h-1) which represent stability fit parameters rather than standard steady-state catalytic activity metrics.
Redundant with catcand-a9387bb2f0dd262e for catalytic metrics, and contains figure caption details of reaction conditions rather than new primary quantitative catalytic metrics.
Redundant with catcand-a9387bb2f0dd262e which provides a more comprehensive set of T10 and T50 values for all studied catalysts.
Background discussion of spinel oxides and literature review of their catalytic properties.
Cited prior work of Zhang and co-workers on ACr2O4 catalysts.
Precursor characterization via thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), not catalytic testing.
Methodological description of reactor setup and flow rate without specific catalytic performance metrics.
Methodological description of how the rate of CO conversion was calculated, without specific experimental values.
Qualitative observation of catalyst activity recovery over time without specific quantitative catalytic metrics.
Stability test details with non-standard activity decrease metric.
Experimental details of TGA/DSC characterization, not catalytic testing.
Catalyst synthesis and annealing conditions, not catalytic testing.
Pretreatment conditions without catalytic performance metrics.
